description: This file contains Swagger API documentation classes for the Clients API in the Fineract project, defining request/response schemas, nested data structures, and API symbols for client-related operations.

classes.name: ClientsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger schemas for client API responses and requests.

classes.name: GetClientsTemplateResponse
classes.description: Schema for the template response when fetching client template data.

classes.name: GetClientsOfficeOptions
classes.description: Represents office options in client template.

classes.name: GetClientsStaffOptions
classes.description: Represents staff options in client template.

classes.name: GetClientsSavingProductOptions
classes.description: Represents saving product options in client template.

classes.name: GetClientsDataTables
classes.description: Represents data table configurations in client template.

classes.name: GetClientsColumnHeaderData
classes.description: Schema for column header data in data tables.

classes.name: GetClientsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response when fetching a list of clients.

classes.name: GetClientsPageItemsResponse
classes.description: Represents individual client item in client list response.

classes.name: GetClientStatus
classes.description: Status information for a client.

classes.name: GetClientsClientIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for detailed client info by client ID.

classes.name: GetClientsTimeline
classes.description: Timeline info for client submission and activation.

classes.name: GetClientsGroups
classes.description: Group info associated with a client.

classes.name: PostClientsRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new client.

classes.name: PostClientsDatatable
classes.description: Data table info in client creation request.

classes.name: PostClientsAddressRequest
classes.description: Address info in client creation request.

classes.name: PostClientsResponse
classes.description: Response after creating a client.

classes.name: PutClientsClientIdRequest
classes.description: Request schema for updating client external ID.

classes.name: PutClientsClientIdResponse
classes.description: Response after updating client external ID.

classes.name: DeleteClientsClientIdRequest
classes.description: Request schema for deleting a client.

classes.name: DeleteClientsClientIdResponse
classes.description: Response after deleting a client.

classes.name: PostClientsClientIdRequest
classes.description: Request schema for associating a client with a client ID.

classes.name: PostClientsClientIdResponse
classes.description: Response after associating a client with a client ID.

classes.name: GetClientTransferProposalDateResponse
classes.description: Schema for transfer proposal date.

classes.name: GetClientObligeeDetailsResponse
classes.description: Details of obligees for a client.

classes.name: GetClientsClientIdAccountsResponse
classes.description: Account info related to a client.
